title: Add scripts-only validation gate
summary: Add a validate.sh mode that runs autonomy, provenance, docs, and repository guardrails without requiring a Rust toolchain.
expectedFailureModes: Contributors in constrained environments cannot run any validation because Rust builds are mandatory.
Scripts-only validation accidentally invokes cargo and fails when Rust tooling is unavailable.
Docs imply script-only validation is equivalent to the full integration gate.
nextAction: Scripts-only validation is implemented and documented; use the full Rust gate before integration when code paths require it.
